source.title: Data Collected with Package Delivery Quadcopter Drone

license_attribution: Rodrigues et al., Data Collected with Package Delivery Quadcopter Drone, Carnegie Mellon University, DOI 10.1184/R1/12683453.v1, CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Modified: battery voltage/current only, causal 1 Hz extraction, no route/position fields.
admission_rule: longest contiguous causal 1 Hz segment, sample at or before tick within 0.4s; finite voltage >0 and finite current; minimum 96 seconds; no target-based error filtering
physical_pack_identity: unavailable; date groups are not independent airframes or physical battery identities
